scope: Linux local-editor Scene2D saved-state preview tab; unreleased development after 0.0.5
features: Build & Run tabs share scene selection while preserving independent build job lifecycle
Static saved scene rendered from the existing portable plan and hash-verified frozen image bytes
Center positions, size, RGBA multiplication, draw order, projection inheritance and explicit overrides
Fit/zoom/pan/grid, accessible object selection, inspector/source navigation, scene edit with refreshed snapshot
Chinese, English and Japanese; 390px layout and keyboard tabs

steps: No Godot is configured: the Preview tab renders both frozen SVG images at inherited/overridden sizes and center positions, with source-aware resolved projection fields. No build job runs.
Real pointer selection opens the correct actor inspector. Zoom, grid, pointer pan and Fit visibly affect only the camera and overlay.
A second layout multiplies the inherited image by its RGBA tint and draws the later actor on top; a real center click selects that top actor.
Explicit imageResourceId:null removes inherited imagery. Arrow-key tab navigation maintains ARIA/focus, while English/Japanese and a 390px viewport retain the same scene without horizontal overflow.
A delayed old-scene response cannot replace a newer scene or restore its old images after rapid selection.
Invalid scene dimensions clear old pixels and show a source-located diagnostic. All previews, tab switches and gestures leave authoring files byte-identical and never create a build job.
Edit scene opens from the preview. Saving updates the title and actor position in a fresh preview while preserving scene UUID, BOM/CRLF and every other authored file.
Actor and original-OC source links return to the corresponding document; reopening Preview retains the selected scene and reads a fresh snapshot. Navigation is read-only.
SVG images render as image content: embedded script and external-image URLs never execute or request network access.

fixedDuringValidation: Image-only CSP permits blob images so controlled local decode works; script policy remains unchanged
Canvas focus prevents scroll so a pointer click selects the intended actor
Parent status polling keeps object/inspector nodes stable and does not steal keyboard focus
Same-scene refresh keeps manual zoom; changed viewport refits
Canvas visible border uses a shadow so CSS border sizing does not shift image and hit coordinates
Disconnected preview requests abort capture and cannot publish a late snapshot
dataAndLifecycle: Preview and camera gestures preserve all authored bytes; browser test separately records the explicitly saved scene edit
At most two retained server snapshots, total verified image bytes <=128MiB; capture serialized; ten-minute TTL, explicit release and shutdown cleanup
No preview disk cache or author directory writes; image decode failure is visible with a placeholder
Browser retained resized image canvases <=64MiB and tint tiles <=32MiB; not a bound on browser transient image decoding
limitations: Static saved layout only: no runtime input, movement, drag-to-write, physics or gameplay
Only Linux local editor capability is exposed in this increment
Browser fonts/SVG rasterization are not promised pixel-identical to Godot
No new installer, Tauri window, Android device or interactive Godot window acceptance this round
Full Rust suite was not repeated; existing unmodified native helpers were rebuilt and exercised by app checks
No version bump, commit, push, installation or production author-data migration
